name: Tilapia
siboNotes: Plain tilapia is excellent for SIBO as it's easily digestible and provides high-quality protein without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil, oregano, or thyme
Cook with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Avoid breading with wheat flour - use rice flour or cornmeal instead
Pan-fry, bake, or grill for easy digestion
